meta.description: Every vehicle in our collection undergoes a rigorous 210-point inspection. The BN Standard is our promise of mechanical and aesthetic integrity.

certification.headline: The BN Standard.
certification.subtitle: Every automobile curated by BN Automobiles undergoes a rigorous 210-point inspection protocol. We do not merely verify maintenance; we validate the soul of the machine through mechanical forensics and aesthetic preservation.
certification.statCaption: Critical validation checkpoints ensuring technical and aesthetic absolute perfection.
certification.pillar1Desc: A forensic examination of every system — from powertrain fluid spectral analysis to thermal imaging of cooling circuits and suspension geometry.
certification.pillar1Item1: Powertrain and transmission fluid spectral analysis
certification.pillar2Desc: Surface integrity examined at a micron level. Every panel, every stitch, every surface assessed against factory specification.
certification.pillar2Item2: UV damage assessment on leather and wood trim
certification.pillar3Desc: A complete chain of custody for every vehicle. Every service record, every ownership transfer, every regulatory checkpoint verified.
certification.darkBandBody: When a vehicle bears the BN Verified seal, it means every structural point has been measured against factory blueprints within a 0.5mm tolerance. It means the provenance is unimpeachable. It means you are buying exactly what we say you are buying.
certification.processSubtitle: What our specialists look at — and why it matters to you.
certification.quoteText: We don't look for what is there; we look for what is missing. A car tells its story through its imperfections. My job is to ensure that story has a perfect next chapter.
certification.ctaTitle: Ready to experience the BN Standard?

price.gstCaption: inclusive of GST margin · TCS applicable
